description: Causes an entity to circle around an anchor point placed near a point or target.

angle_change.description: Number of degrees to change this entity's facing by, when the entity selects its next anchor point.

goal_radius.description: Maximum distance from the anchor-point in which this entity considers itself to have reached the anchor point.

height_above_target_range.description: The number of blocks above the target that the next anchor point can be set.

height_adjustment_chance.description: Percent chance to determine how often to increase or decrease the current height around the anchor point.

height_offset_range.description: Vertical distance from the anchor point this entity must stay within, upon a successful height adjustment.

priority.description: As priority approaches 0, the priority is increased. The higher the priority, the sooner this behavior will be executed as a goal.

radius_adjustment_chance.description: Percent chance to determine how often to increase the size of the current movement radius around the anchor point.

radius_change.description: The number of blocks to increase the current movement radius by, upon successful "radius_adjustment_chance".

radius_range.description: Horizontal distance from the anchor point this entity must stay within upon a successful radius adjustment.

speed_multiplier.description: Multiplies the speed at which this entity travels to its next desired position.

height_change_chance.description: Chance per tick to change height (out of 1000).

radius_change_chance.description: Chance per tick to change the circle radius (out of 1000).
